code='''def transform(grid):

 bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]; mark=next(v for v in range(10) if v!=bg and any(v in row for row in grid))

 out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 for c in range(c0,c1+1):
  if grid[r0][c]==bg: out[r0][c]=2
  if grid[r1][c]==bg: out[r1][c]=2
 for r in range(r0,r1+1):
  if grid[r][c0]==bg: out[r][c0]=2
  if grid[r][c1]==bg: out[r][c1]=2
 return out
''';open(p,'w').write(code); exec(code,globals());out=transform(g);print(out)
